Sol and Terra were the killers, and Sol got caught early after jumping between Haiku and Gemma on day one. On night two, Sonnet the doctor protected Luna and was killed for it. Gemma then claimed to be the officer and called Luna safe, but her contradictory checks and her sudden claim that Luna was the killer convinced the town she was lying, so they lynched her. Haiku the jester was killed on night three, leaving Terra and Luna, and the killers won.
